paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about an online study workshop, which I attended at the community centre. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dịch vụ, nơi và mục đích phàn nàn.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to complain about [sự kiện / hoạt động], which I attended at [địa điểm]. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.label: Hai vấn đề
paragraphs.text: The first problem was that there was almost no time for the advertised practical activity. In addition, the session started forty minutes late without an explanation. I had expected a practical opportunity to try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group, so these problems were particularly disappointing.
